steps: Cancel 15 with 5, which leaves 3 and 1, and 48 with 4, which leaves 12 and 1: 3 × 12 = 36.
Milk in 5 cups is 1/4 litre, so milk in 1 cup is 1/4 ÷ 5.
As a multiplication: 5 times the milk in one cup = 1/4.
The reciprocal of the divisor 5 is 1/5; multiply the dividend by it: 1/5 × 1/4 = 1/20.

M3.S16.T16.C69#0.question: Pāṭīgaṇita, a book written by Sridharacharya in the 9th century of the Common Era, mentions this problem: "Friend, after thinking, what sum will be obtained by adding together 1 ÷ (1/6), 1 ÷ (1/10), 1 ÷ (1/13), 1 ÷ (1/9), and 1 ÷ (1/2)". What should the friend say?
